##: Upstream Go native desktop downloader (Bilibili / Douyin / YouTube). The Windows asset videodown-windows-amd64.zip has a top-level videodown/ folder containing videodown.exe plus a standalone updater. By default the app writes config.toml / history.sqlite / download next to the exe, which Scoop would wipe on version bumps, so post_install generates a videodown.cmd launcher that pins data to %LOCALAPPDATA%\videodown via -data and disables the in-app auto updater. checkver reads tag_name from the GitHub API; autoupdate takes sha256 from the API digest.
description: 哔哩哔哩 / 抖音 / YouTube 视频下载器（Go 原生桌面 GUI）
notes: 绿色版：zip 内 videodown/videodown.exe 为 Go 原生 GUI；运行 videodown 启动，无需 Node/CGO
数据目录固定在 %LOCALAPPDATA%\videodown（config.toml / history.sqlite / download），Scoop 升级不会丢登录 Cookie 与下载历史；首次安装会写入默认配置并关闭应用内自动更新，避免与 Scoop 升级冲突
下载哔哩哔哩与 YouTube 视频需另装 FFmpeg，并在设置中指定路径或加入 PATH
